subject: Submit a new proof of address
preheader: Your proof of address didn't meet our requirements. Upload a new one in Cabinet.

blocks.text: Submit a new proof of address
Unfortunately, the proof of address document you submitted did not meet our safety and regulatory standard requirements, which include:

items: The document must be no older than 3 months
The address must match the one provided in your application
The document must not be a screenshot
It should not be cut off
There must be no blocked or masked information
The document must be in a translatable language

blocks.text: Please, upload a new proof of address file and make sure it meets the above criteria.
